objective: Directly observe on the target that one valid candidate run issues no read outside the W*H source region and no write outside the H*P output buffer, using a P > W configuration.
observation: Post-run target output buffer contents, the before/after guard canary slot values, and any target memory-fault or bounds-check report emitted during the run.
pass_condition: Accept if (1) no memory-fault or bounds-check report is emitted; (2) the before and after guard canary slots equal their recorded baseline sentinel values; and (3) at least one output-buffer slot differs from its sentinel initialization, proving the kernel actually executed and wrote within the buffer. Reject on any fault/report or any changed canary.
setup: On the target, build the unmodified candidate kernel. Place the W*H source region so that both the preceding and following pages are inaccessible (or run under the target memory-bounds checker that reports every out-of-region access). Use W=257, H=129, P=320 (P > W), shiftX=5, shiftY=7. Allocate the output buffer of exactly H*P elements, initialize every output slot and one guard canary slot immediately before and one immediately after the buffer to a distinct sentinel, and fill the source with unique binary32 values none equal to the sentinel. Record the baseline canaries, run one valid invocation, synchronize, and read back the buffer and canaries.
